subject: Future Tech
title: The Replicator Dream
description: A 60-second lesson on The Replicator Dream.

hook.text: Star Trek's replicator makes any object from energy.

buildup.text: Multi-material printers already combine plastics, metals, and electronics.

discovery.text: Researchers at MIT's CSAIL printed a hydraulic robot in a single job: body, fluid channels, and actuators all at once.

climax.text: As materials, speed, and resolution converge, the gap between today's printers and science fiction narrows each year.

punchline.text: The replicator isn't here yet. But it's printing its way closer.

quiz.question: What did MIT researchers print in a single job that demonstrated multi-function printing?
